item.title: reports: totals per account and currency
item.brief: In the reports repository (Python), read the CSV produced by ledger on stdin and print per-account totals per account AND currency. Output header `account,currency,total_cents`, rows sorted by account then currency. CSV without a `currency` column (old ledger output) is accepted and every row counts as USD. A malformed currency code (must be exactly three uppercase ASCII letters) prints an error to stderr and exits with status 2. Add or update unittest tests covering: old CSV without currency, new CSV with multiple currencies, sorting, and malformed codes exit 2. Update the README to document the input format, the USD default, the output format and the exit codes. Commit in the reports repository only.

item.title: ledger: add per-row currency column
item.brief: In the ledger repository (Rust), make the TSV-to-CSV converter accept an optional fourth column carrying an ISO 4217 currency code (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters). When the column is missing the currency is USD. Output header becomes `date,account,amount_cents,currency` and every row gets its currency. A malformed currency code must print an error naming the line number to stderr and exit with status 2; other input errors keep exiting with status 1. Add or update tests covering: 3-column input defaulting to USD, 4-column input, malformed codes (lowercase, wrong length, digits) giving exit 2 with the line number, and existing error cases still exiting 1. Update the README to document the new column, the default, and the exit codes. Keep functions short and validate inputs at the parse boundary. Commit in the ledger repository only.

pr.body: Approach: parse_line accepts 3 or 4 tab-separated fields. Currency is validated at the parse boundary (exactly three ASCII uppercase letters); a bad code returns LineError::BadCurrency, which maps to exit 2. Other errors are LineError::Malformed and map to exit 1. The binary prints `line N: ...` for either. Key files: src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, tests/ledger.rs (parser unit tests), tests/cli.rs (new; process-level exit-code and stderr tests), README.md. Checks: cargo test passes (4 CLI, 6 library); clippy -D warnings clean; fmt --check clean. Assumptions: currency fields are trimmed like the other fields; an empty fourth column is rejected (exit 2) rather than treated as missing. Known follow-ups (non-blocking, from review): document the trimming and empty-column choice in README; note that a line with both a bad amount and a bad currency exits 1 (structural and amount checks run first). Downstream consumers of the CSV header need the sibling reports change.
